longBusinessSummary: Franklin Covey Co. provides training and consulting services and related products in Australia, Austria, China, France, Germany, Ireland, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: North America, International, and Education Division. The company offers a suite of individual and leadership-development training content based on books, including the 7 Habits of Highly Effective People, the Speed of Trust, Multipliers, the 4 Disciplines of Execution, and Trust and Inspire, as well as content in the areas of execution, sales performance, productivity, customer loyalty, leadership, and education. It also owns international licensees to provide offerings and services.
